fullDescription: A sophisticated light-themed neumorphic (Soft UI) design system specifically optimized for SaaS admin dashboards, portfolios, and configuration panels. It utilizes a soft color palette based on #e0e5ec with high-precision shadows to create a tactile, three-dimensional physical surface. Key features include editorial typography with General Sans and Satoshi, scroll-triggered cascade animations, and complex interactive components like grid-based accordions and custom neumorphic toggles. The style is ideal for fintech, creative tools, and professional settings requiring a modern, clean, yet distinct interface.
prompt:
## Resumo
A clean, high-fidelity Neumorphic Admin Dashboard featuring tactile UI elements, sophisticated typography pairing, and fluid micro-interactions. The interface uses a consistent light-gray base to create depth through shadow manipulation rather than color contrast.

## Estilo Visual
Create a neumorphic light mode interface using base color #e0e5ec. Typography: Use 'General Sans' for headings (weights 600, 700) and 'Satoshi' for body text (weights 400, 500). Color Palette: Base: #e0e5ec; Highlights: #ffffff; Shadows: #a3b1c6; Accent Indigo: #6366f1; Heading Text: #2d3436; Body Text: #44475a. UI Surface Rules: 1. Flat surfaces (nm-flat): box-shadow: 6px 6px 12px #a3b1c6, -6px -6px 12px #ffffff. 2. Inset surfaces (nm-inset): box-shadow: inset 4px 4px 8px #a3b1c6, inset -4px -4px 8px #ffffff. 3. Interactive buttons (nm-button): Same as flat but on hover transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.02) and on active: inset shadow. All transitions must use cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) over 0.35s. Implement a cascade-in animation for page loads where elements slide up 20px while fading in over 0.6s with a stagger.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Fixed Sidebar
Sidebar: width 72 (288px), fixed position, height 100vh. Background: #e0e5ec. Include a logo area with a rounded-2xl container using nm-flat style. Navigation links (sidebar-link) should have a transparent background by default, 5px translation on hover, and an nm-inset shadow with accent color text when active. Spacing: p-6 with items spaced by 12px.

### Sticky Header
Header: height 80px, sticky top-0, z-index 40. Rounded-2xl container with nm-flat styling. Left side: Breadcrumb navigation with chevron-right icons (text-slate-300). Right side: Action group containing 40x40px circular nm-buttons for theme toggle and notifications, and a gradient profile avatar (indigo to purple).

### Main Content Grid
Main content: max-width 4xl (896px), centered. Title section: 32px bold heading with 14px medium subtext. Content blocks: Stacked accordion-style cards with 28px border-radius and nm-flat styling. Inner spacing: p-8. Vertical rhythm: 24px gap between major sections.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Neumorphic Accordion Card — Tactile expandable card component using CSS grid for height transitions.
Create an accordion card with a 28px border radius and nm-flat shadow. The header should be a button with a 48x48px nm-inset icon container and a chevron that rotates 180 degrees. The content area must use 'display: grid' with 'grid-template-rows: 0fr' (closed) to '1fr' (open) and 'transition: grid-template-rows 0.4s' to enable smooth height animation without hard-coded heights.

### Neumorphic Toggle Switch — A 48x24px custom checkbox styled as a physical slider.
Toggle Switch: 48px width, 24px height. Track: nm-inset shadow, #e0e5ec background, 34px radius. Thumb: 16px circle, background #a3b1c6, box-shadow 2px 2px 4px #a3b1c6. Transition: 0.4s ease. Active state: Thumb translates 24px and changes to #6366f1.

### Tactile Form Inputs — Inset inputs that feel carved into the UI surface.
Inputs: background #e0e5ec, border: none, outline: none. Shadow: inset 4px 4px 8px #a3b1c6, inset -4px -4px 8px #ffffff. Border-radius: 16px. Padding: 14px 20px. Text: 14px Satoshi, color #44475a.

style.description: The style essence is 'Modern Tactile Minimalism'. It relies on a monotone base color (#e0e5ec) with white highlights (#ffffff) and cool gray shadows (#a3b1c6) to define hierarchy. Typography pairs 'General Sans' for bold, structural headings with 'Satoshi' for readable body text. Animations prioritize physical momentum using custom cubic-bezier curves for transitions and entry effects.
